license: NVIDIA Isaac Sim / Omniverse license accepted by the operator before the run; these scripts never accept it (operator-written marker file)
method: bench_physics_only.py: gym.make of the registered task; per control step one action a~U[-1,1]^37 (JointPositionAction: target = default pose + 0.5 a, held), then decimation x (apply_action, scene.write_data_to_sim, sim.step(render=False), scene.update); no MDP managers or resets inside the timed loop; env.reset() before each round; median over timed rounds, sync at round ends

runs.label: physx_task_n1024

describe.asset: G1_MINIMAL_CFG (g1_minimal.usd, 3 box colliders: both feet, torso)

runs.command: python scripts/physx_bench/bench_physics_only.py --task Isaac-Velocity-Flat-G1 --num_envs 1024 --label physx_task_n1024 --out runs/physx_task_n1024.json --baseline_mem_mib 102.0 physics=isaacsim_physx

contacts.note: proxy from Isaac Lab's ContactSensor: bodies with net contact force > 1e-3 N, at round ends
